usages.explain: 以後（いご）expresses a time that occurs after a certain point, some event.

examples.content: それ以後佐藤先生に会っていません。
examples.transcription: それいごさとうせんせいにあっていません。
examples.mean: I haven't seen Mr. Sato since then.

examples.content: 午後6時半以後はひまだ。
examples.transcription: ごご6じはんいごはひまだ。
examples.mean: There is no time left after 6:30pm.

title: いご => after this, from now on, hereafter, thereafter, since
